240-728-4460-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1987-3075-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3075-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1987-3075-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3075-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2510-3532-5078-5957.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2511-5671-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3140-3835-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4050-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-6752.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1379-1597-1978.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat

1850-2573-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2573-5414.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

3668-6598.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Flesh Duplicate's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Flesh Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1563-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-2173-4423-5967-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
1315-2173-4423-5967-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
1315-2173-4423-5967-6491.notablePrerequisites:
Walk-in Closet is unlocked.
You control three or more Islands.
1315-2173-4423-5967-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

2100-4113-5851.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {3}, tapping Stormsplitter, and tapping Caetus.
Stormsplitter triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4} and tapping the token copy of Stormsplitter.
Both Stormsplitters trigger, creating two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {3} and tapping two token copies of Stormsplitter.
All four copies of Stormsplitter trigger, creating four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {1} and tapping four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by tapping five token copies of Stormsplitter.
Repeat from step 11.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of River Kelpie

2921-3388-3607.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its persist ability and its static effect.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it and River Kelpie's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it. 
Repeat.

2757-4222-5467.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Wylie Duke.
2757-4222-5467.notablePrerequisites:
Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Island.
2757-4222-5467.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

1013-2178-4227.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1013-2178-4227.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1283-1641-2034-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {2}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2-3519-4115.manaNeeded: {4} plus enough mana to cast the additional creature
2-3519-4115.notablePrerequisites:
You do not control another Golem or have a Golem in your graveyard.
You have another creature card in hand that is not a Golem and that does not share a creature type with a creature you control or a creature in your graveyard.
If the additional creature has multiple differently colored mana symbols in its mana cost, an additional mana of each but one of those symbols will be required.
2-3519-4115.description:
Cast the additional creature by paying its mana cost.
Volo triggers, copying the creature spell.
Resolve both creature spells.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the creature token, adding at least one mana of any color that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Volo triggers, copying Ancestral Statue.
Resolve the copy of the Ancestral Statue spell.
When the token Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning a nontoken creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the Ancestral Statue token, adding five mana of any color that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Resolve the original Ancestral Statue spell cast in step 5.
When the nontoken Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

435-570-747-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder and Go-Shintai do not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Shrine.
You control a black and a red permanent.
435-570-747-1636.description:
Activate Auratog by sacrificing another nontoken Shrine, giving Auratog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning any Shrine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Shrine enters the battlefield, triggering Go-Shintai, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
The Shrine token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4152-4222-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Undercity Scrounger.
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
4152-4222-4772.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.

1724-2584.description:
Cast Sekki by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Sekki enters, Pandemonium triggers, targeting Sekki. Sekki prevents the 8 damage that would be dealt to it and instead removes eight +1/+1 counters from Sekki and creates eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Sekki dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Spirits enter, Pandemonium triggers that many times, dealing a total of 8 damage divided among any number of targets.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing the eight Spirit tokens, returning Sekki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
